about: The games FlashGames can pick from, for the weekly planner (.claude/skills/flashgames-week/SKILL.md). A game is listed here once its FlashGames mode (docs/PROTOCOL.md) is live. notInRotation records games that were looked at and why they are out.

games.name: Dungeon Joe
games.check: npm run typecheck; npm run lint; npm test; npm run build
games.deploy: Commit and push main of the games repo (C:\dev\DungeonJoe). Its deploy workflow builds Dungeon Joe and republishes the whole /games/ site (about 5 minutes).

games.name: The Infinite Hive
games.check: node build.mjs, then a browser check of ?flash= runs
games.deploy: Not a git repo: back up src/ first. Bump VERSION, node build.mjs, copy 'The Infinite Hive.html' to C:\dev\DungeonJoe\deploy\infinitehive\index.html and flash.json beside it, then commit and push the games repo.

games.name: Geode Gobbler: the Gobble Saloon
games.check: node build.mjs, then a browser check of ?flash= runs
games.deploy: Not a git repo: back up src/ first. Bump VERSION, node build.mjs, copy dist/index.html to C:\dev\DungeonJoe\deploy\geodegobbler\index.html and flash.json beside it, then commit and push the games repo with a 'Geode Gobbler vX.Y.Z: ...' message.

games.name: Alt Whisker Wars
games.check: the repo's own checks (see its README), then a browser check of ?flash= runs
games.deploy: Push main. Its ready workflow updates the ready branch; the games site picks it up within 10 minutes, or right away with: gh workflow run deploy.yml -R roamingjackmans-pixel/games

games.name: Smash Your Bros
games.check: npm run typecheck; npm test; npm run build
games.deploy: Push main. Its ready workflow updates the ready branch; the games site picks it up within 10 minutes, or right away with: gh workflow run deploy.yml -R roamingjackmans-pixel/games

games.name: Shoallhell
games.check: npm run typecheck; npm test; npm run build
games.deploy: Push main (the page goes out through its ready workflow and the games site). Only when server/ changed: fly deploy in C:\dev\Shoallhell (that server also hosts the FlashGames boards).

notInRotation.why: The owner left it out at launch (2026-11-23). Ask him before adding it.
